description.content:
### What is it?

Represents the landing pages associated with a list.

Use this resource to retrieve the landing pages that are defined for the list.  The single collection
response is sorted by the generated landing page `id` and paginated using `next_collection_link` and
`prev_collection_link` properties.  See
[How Collections are Represented](#collection-representation) for details on collection traversal.

### Related endpoints

* [Landing Pages](#tag/Landing-Pages)

### Related code examples

* [Get Landing Pages](#tag/Get-Landing-Pages)
This endpoint is used to get a paginated collection of list landing pages.

query.description: The pagination total entries to retrieve

oauth2.value: account.read landing-page.read list.read list.write subscriber.read subscriber.write subscriber.read-extended email.read email.write

response.name: The request completed successfully
